route: 2D closed-cell streamfunction dye, pure transport spatial operator
scope: reserved numerical verification after endpoint code freeze; no complete ocean evolution or physical all-layer certification
coordinates: x periodic and uniform; y in [0,L]; depth d in [0,H] positive downward
physical_continuum_truth: v_y+a_d=0; v*T_y+a*T_d=0; therefore conservative transport tendency=0; closed-wall normal velocities vanish
sampling: horizontal cell-centred nodes, vertical physical nodes including endpoints; nodal dual control-volume weights; continuity-consistent Fz from the actual production divergence
numerical_settings: nodal_dual_v1, symmetric, closed_faces, centered_fourth pressure/continuity, centered_second tracer, muscl_nodal_v1; all mixing zero; dt=10 only constructs params, no state stepping

criteria.refinement: each weighted-L1 residual decreases by at least factor 1.25 unless already below normalized 1e-12 roundoff floor
criteria.corruption: reverse Fz while retaining horizontal velocity; constant preservation check must reject above 1e-12

if_failed: report OPEN, retain all cases/inputs, no correction-to-pass counted as pristine validation
shared_assumptions: prescribed continuum transport equation and native sampling; production Fz participates in operator assembly, so this is not all-layer-disjoint certification
